title: Gears pulley description, version 6
description: Static structure and scalar limits of a GT2 timing pulley, a smooth idler pulley, an involute gear with straight, helical or herringbone teeth, or a straight bevel gear. Cross-field geometry rules are defined in docs/contract.md.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of the persisted input format. Version 1 kept a round bore as hub.boreDiameter, versions 1 and 2 called rim.width toothedWidth and had timing pulleys only, version 3 added the idler pulley and the spur gear but placed the web by thickness and mid-plane and measured hub extensions from the rim ends; readers upgrade them. Version 4 placed the web and the hub against the faces of the part. Version 5 renames spurGear to gear and adds helical teeth; a version 4 gear gets rim.helix "none". Version 6 adds web.hubTaper and web.rimTaper; a version 5 web gets 0 for both, a cylindrical hub and rim.

kind.description: Part kind; it selects the rim. Flanges (absent on gears), web, hub and bore are shared.

units.description: Unit for every dimensional input and output unless explicitly stated otherwise.

generator.description: Optional note naming the program that wrote the file, for example "Gears 1.0.0 by Ivan Polyacov, apus-software.com/gears". It carries no geometry and is dropped on normalization.

width.description: Axial width of the rim working surface, centered on z=0 from -width/2 to +width/2. Flanges add their thickness outside it; the faces of the part are the flange far faces, or the rim ends without flanges.

radialThickness.description: Radial material thickness inward from the lowest point of the working surface (tooth root or smooth surface) to the inner rim radius.

profile.description: Experimental polyline derived from the legacy prototype; pitch and outside diameter are verified, exact groove shape is not.

toothCount.description: Number of equally spaced pulley grooves.

outerDiameter.description: Diameter of the smooth cylindrical surface the belt runs on.

module.description: Normal module m in mm, across the tooth: pitch diameter is m·toothCount/cos β, circular pitch along the pitch circle π·m/cos β. Mating gears share the module, the pressure angle and the helix angle.

pressureAngle.description: Pressure angle of the basic rack, degrees; for helical teeth the normal one.

profileShift.description: Profile shift coefficient x: the rack moves outwards by x·module; addendum is (1 + x)·module, dedendum (1.25 − x)·module.

backlash.description: Thinning of every tooth along the pitch circle, mm, across the tooth for helical teeth; a pair at the standard centre distance gets the sum of both gears as play.

helix.description: Teeth: straight, helical, or herringbone: two helical halves of opposite hands meeting at the mid-plane without a gap. The hand is the sign of helixAngle.

helixAngle.description: Helix angle β at the pitch cylinder, degrees; present only when helix is not none. Positive is right-hand: the tooth rises counter-clockwise seen from +Z, like a right-hand thread; a herringbone takes the hand of its lower half. Mating gears on parallel axes have opposite signs; 0 gives straight teeth.

bevelRim.description: Straight bevel gear: the teeth lie on the pitch cone and every tooth line runs to its apex. Tooth sizes are those of the large end, which is the lower face; the teeth are those of the virtual spur gear on the back cone with toothCount/cos δ teeth (Tredgold's approximation). The lower face passes through the tip circle of the large end, the upper face is width higher; the small end is the large one scaled towards the apex.

module.description: Module m of the large end, mm: the pitch diameter of the large end is m·toothCount, the circular pitch along it π·m. Mating gears share the module and the pressure angle.

toothCount.description: Number of teeth of this gear.

mateToothCount.description: Number of teeth of the mating bevel gear. With the shaft angle Σ it sets the pitch cone angle δ: tan δ = sin Σ / (mateToothCount/toothCount + cos Σ). The mating gear has the two counts swapped.

shaftAngle.description: Angle Σ between the axes of the pair, degrees; both gears of a pair have the same. The pitch cone angles of the pair add up to Σ.

axialThickness.description: Axial flange thickness measured away from the rim end.

radialExtension.description: Radial projection beyond the outside radius of the working surface (tooth tips or smooth surface).

lower.description: Flange below z=-width/2; null means absent.

upper.description: Flange above z=+width/2; null means absent.

thinning.description: How much thinner the web or spokes are than the part between its faces; 0 is a web through the whole height, flanges included. The web keeps at least 1 mm.

alignment.description: Face the web is placed against: its lower plane on the lower face, its upper plane on the upper face, or centred between them.

axialOffset.description: Shift of the web from its aligned position; positive is toward the upper side. The web stays between the faces of the part.

hubTaper.description: Angle from the axis at which the hub widens towards the web, degrees; 0 keeps it cylindrical. hub.outerDiameter is the size at the faces of the part. The widening is the lower height between the web and a face times the tangent of the angle; when the hub and rim cones leave too little room between them at the web, both shrink in proportion and the angle stays.

rimTaper.description: Angle from the axis at which the rim thickens inward towards the web, degrees; 0 keeps its inner surface cylindrical. rim.radialThickness is the thickness at the faces of the part.

type.description: A continuous annular web between hub and rim.

No web: the rim material goes down to the hub over the whole height of the part, as on a pinion. rim.radialThickness is kept but not used; the hub has to stay at least 0.5 mm inside the tooth roots or the smooth surface.
Equally spaced straight radial spokes with mandatory in-plane fillets.

count.description: Number of equally spaced straight radial spokes.

width.description: Tangential width of each straight spoke before root fillets.

filletRadius.description: In-plane radius of both hub-to-spoke and spoke-to-rim fillets.

outerDiameter.description: Outside diameter of the cylindrical hub.

lowerExtension.description: Hub projection below the lower face of the part (lower flange far face or rim end); 0 is flush, negative ends the hub above that face. The hub always spans the web.

upperExtension.description: Hub projection above the upper face of the part (upper flange far face or rim end); 0 is flush, negative ends the hub below that face. The hub always spans the web.

diameter.description: Bore circle diameter; for a polygon, the diameter of its circumscribed circle (across corners).

sides.description: Number of sides of a regular polygonal bore; one side faces +X.

flatDistance.description: Distance from the flat, which faces +X, to the opposite side of the bore circle.

keyWidth.description: Width of the keyway, which runs along the +X ray.

keyDepth.description: Keyway depth beyond the bore circle, measured along the +X ray.

shape.description: A round through bore truncated by one flat (D shape).
A round through bore with one rectangular keyway.

maxChordError.description: Maximum radial sagitta in millimetres for generated circular arcs; it is a meshing setting, not a physical dimension.
